# Burns And Allen

**Recordings:** 37

## Background

George Burns and Gracie Allen developed a radio comedy partnership built around Burns's straight-man delivery and Allen's deliberately illogical observations. Their long-running radio series evolved from vaudeville-style exchanges into domestic situation comedy and later made a successful transition to television. [Source: Smithsonian collection](https://www.si.edu/object/siris_sil_548054).
